the payment's recorded (credited) time.

latestAt.description:
The statutory hard limit: equal to `due_at`, except that a card, transfer or BLIK
advance, still due promptly, breaches the law only after the earlier of its local
month's end and sale completion.

TableSearch_AgentDocumentFilter_Document.description:
`POST …/search`: a table read with body-only criteria, an allowlisted sort and a cursor.

Personal criteria, including `q`, belong only in `search`. Empty sorting uses the service
default; at most 100 keys are accepted. The `cursor` object is required and its token
optional; `limit` defaults to `min(50, ClientLimits.max_page_size)`. Handlers must be
side-effect free.
